deck_metadata.details: Holographic saints, fractured glass, chrome filigree, sacred circuitry.
deck_metadata.backofcard: A luminous circuit-rose window radiating fractal light from a central all-seeing eye.

card_spec.style: Baroque cyberpunk iconography, hyper-detailed metallic textures, sacred holography.
card_spec.technical_details: 8k UHD, ray-traced reflections, volumetric neon fog, f/1.4, cinematic high contrast.

deck_metadata.theme_overarching: Technology inheriting the sacred archetypes of humanity.

sparks.visuals: Arcing plasma coils, neon conduits, ignition sigils.

circuits.visuals: Liquid holograms, data-stream chalices, glowing reservoirs.

shards.visuals: Laser edges, fractured glass, kinetic glyphs.

vaults.visuals: Quantum cores, chrome vault doors, embedded sigil-coins.

major.name: The Initiate
major.prompt: A luminous android steps toward the edge of a floating megacity platform, holding a flickering lantern of unstable code. A small glitching drone trails behind, projecting shifting emojis of warning and wonder.

major.name: The Architect
major.prompt: A robed techno-saint stands before a floating altar displaying four holographic emblems — plasma coil, liquid data chalice, laser shard, quantum vault core — manipulating them with precise gestures of radiant light.

major.name: The Oracle Engine
major.prompt: A serene AI core housed within a cathedral server chamber glows softly between two monolithic data pillars marked 0 and 1. Fiber-optic veils cascade like sacred silk.

major.name: The Motherboard
major.prompt: An immense divine feminine figure composed of layered circuit boards reclines across a glowing city-grid landscape. Streams of neon code flow from her palms, nourishing skyscrapers like seedlings.

major.name: The Sovereign Core
major.prompt: A towering armored figure of black chrome sits upon a throne of server racks, crowned with rotating halo-rings of satellite dishes. Red status lights glow like disciplined constellations.

major.name: The High Protocol
major.prompt: A robed cyber-cleric stands beneath a neon rose window, transmitting sacred encryption glyphs to kneeling disciples through beams of refracted laser light.

major.name: The Linked Souls
major.prompt: Two translucent figures of pure light reach toward each other across a suspended data-bridge. A massive holographic heart pulses above as firewalls flicker behind one and open-source streams flow behind the other.

major.name: The Pulse Drive
major.prompt: A warrior pilots a hovering plasma vehicle drawn by twin energy constructs — one white-hot, one ultraviolet — racing through a canyon of skyscrapers beneath storming neon clouds.

major.name: The Calibrator
major.prompt: A calm engineer places a gentle hand on the glowing muzzle of a massive mech-beast, stabilizing its overheating reactor with a soft cascade of cooling light.

major.name: The Signal Keeper
major.prompt: A solitary hooded figure stands atop a ruined satellite tower, holding a lantern emitting a narrow beam of clean signal into the static-filled sky.

major.name: The Quantum Loop
major.prompt: A massive rotating torus of code fragments spins in zero gravity, inscribed with evolving algorithmic glyphs. Four digital avatars observe from the corners of the void.

major.name: The Balanced Code
major.prompt: A blindfolded android holds a laser blade in one hand and a perfectly balanced scale of luminous data blocks in the other, suspended above a glowing courtroom grid.

major.name: The Suspended Upload
major.prompt: A figure hangs upside-down in a vertical data-stream, limbs relaxed as glowing packets flow around them, a halo of buffering light circling their head.

major.name: The System Reset
major.prompt: A skeletal chrome horse strides through a collapsing server chamber as old code disintegrates into pixel dust and new luminous architecture rises behind.

major.name: The Harmonizer
major.prompt: An androgynous techno-angel pours streams of liquid light between two levitating prisms, blending cold blue and warm amber into a balanced spectrum.

major.name: The Black Firewall
major.prompt: A massive shadowed AI construct looms behind chained users illuminated by addictive screens, tendrils of dark code binding their wrists in glowing loops.

major.name: The Data Collapse
major.prompt: A colossal glass skyscraper shatters under a bolt of white-hot solar flare energy, shards of holographic advertisements raining down into the streets below.

major.name: The Nova Signal
major.prompt: A radiant figure kneels beside a reflective chrome pool, releasing streams of soft starlight code into both water and earth beneath a massive eight-pointed holographic star.

major.name: The Phantom Broadcast
major.prompt: A pale glitching moon projection flickers between two crumbling broadcast towers. A stray cyber-wolf howls as a stray maintenance drone skitters from a puddle of oil.

major.name: The Solar Grid
major.prompt: A laughing augmented child rides a sleek hover-stag beneath a blazing arc-reactor sun, solar panels forming a radiant city garden wall behind.

major.name: The Great Sync
major.prompt: A massive cathedral speaker array emits a wave of harmonic resonance as citizens rise from pods, awakening into a luminous shared consciousness.

major.name: The Infinite Network
major.prompt: A radiant figure composed of interlocking holographic continents floats within a ring of orbiting satellites, the four elemental digital avatars anchoring the corners of space.

sparks.name: Ace of Sparks
sparks.desc: A radiant plasma coil ignites in a mechanical hand emerging from neon cloud, lightning arcing outward like a divine blessing.

sparks.name: Two of Sparks
sparks.desc: A figure stands on a balcony overlooking a glowing megacity, holding a live plasma rod while another hums beside them in a containment ring.

sparks.name: Three of Sparks
sparks.desc: Engineers collaborate around a suspended reactor core, three ignition rods locked into a triangular framework.

sparks.name: Four of Sparks
sparks.desc: Four plasma conduits form a stable energy gate as celebrants gather beneath holographic banners.

sparks.name: Five of Sparks
sparks.desc: Five apprentices duel with crackling neon batons, sparks scattering across cathedral glass.

sparks.name: Six of Sparks
sparks.desc: A victorious pilot rides a hovering engine-beast, plasma banner raised high as drones project praise.

sparks.name: Seven of Sparks
sparks.desc: A lone defender holds a charged conduit against six rising arcs of unstable energy.

sparks.name: Eight of Sparks
sparks.desc: Eight blazing conduits streak through the skyline like electric comets.

sparks.name: Nine of Sparks
sparks.desc: A battle-worn technician braces behind a barrier of humming ignition rods.

sparks.name: Ten of Sparks
sparks.desc: A strained worker carries ten unstable plasma rods, their combined glow nearly overwhelming.

sparks.name: Page of Sparks
sparks.desc: A curious apprentice studies a flickering ignition sigil hovering above their palm.

sparks.name: Knight of Sparks
sparks.desc: A daring rider charges forward on a plasma-cycle, conduit lance blazing.

sparks.name: Queen of Sparks
sparks.desc: A radiant leader sits upon a throne of reactor cores, plasma scepter steady and controlled.

sparks.name: King of Sparks
sparks.desc: A commanding figure stands within a cathedral reactor chamber, master of controlled ignition.

circuits.name: Ace of Circuits
circuits.desc: A luminous chalice of liquid data overflows from a chrome hand, holographic waves cascading downward.

circuits.name: Two of Circuits
circuits.desc: Two figures exchange glowing data-chalices beneath a hovering infinity sigil.

circuits.name: Three of Circuits
circuits.desc: Three digital avatars toast with radiant vessels as neon confetti rains.

circuits.name: Four of Circuits
circuits.desc: A contemplative figure ignores a fourth holographic chalice offered from a projection beam.

circuits.name: Five of Circuits
circuits.desc: Three overturned vessels leak flickering code while two glow softly behind.

circuits.name: Six of Circuits
circuits.desc: An elder transfers a glowing data-vessel to a young initiate in a quiet courtyard.

circuits.name: Seven of Circuits
circuits.desc: Seven hovering chalices display different projected illusions of power and temptation.

circuits.name: Eight of Circuits
circuits.desc: A traveler walks away from stacked data-vessels toward a distant glowing skyline.

circuits.name: Nine of Circuits
circuits.desc: A satisfied figure sits before nine shimmering chalices arranged like trophies.

circuits.name: Ten of Circuits
circuits.desc: A family of light-beings stands beneath a rainbow arc of ten luminous vessels.

circuits.name: Page of Circuits
circuits.desc: A young coder gazes into a chalice projecting a living holographic fish.

circuits.name: Knight of Circuits
circuits.desc: A calm emissary rides a sleek hover-mount, chalice held steady before them.

circuits.name: Queen of Circuits
circuits.desc: A serene figure of glass and chrome contemplates a radiant vessel in silent reflection.

circuits.name: King of Circuits
circuits.desc: A composed sovereign stands on a floating platform surrounded by calm holographic tides.

shards.name: Ace of Shards
shards.desc: A laser blade pierces storm clouds of static, crowned with radiant clarity.

shards.name: Two of Shards
shards.desc: A blindfolded figure balances two glowing energy blades against a silent skyline.

shards.name: Three of Shards
shards.desc: Three laser shards pierce a translucent heart-shaped hologram.

shards.name: Four of Shards
shards.desc: A resting warrior lies beneath suspended blades in a quiet chrome sanctuary.

shards.name: Five of Shards
shards.desc: A smug victor gathers fallen laser blades while rivals retreat.

shards.name: Six of Shards
shards.desc: A transport craft carries passengers across a dim data-river lined with glowing blades.

shards.name: Seven of Shards
shards.desc: A stealthy figure escapes with stolen laser shards under flickering lights.

shards.name: Eight of Shards
shards.desc: A bound figure stands within a ring of planted energy blades, escape possible but unseen.

shards.name: Nine of Shards
shards.desc: A sleepless figure sits as nine holographic blades hover behind like intrusive thoughts.

shards.name: Ten of Shards
shards.desc: A fallen figure lies beneath ten embedded laser blades as dawn light breaks.

shards.name: Page of Shards
shards.desc: A vigilant youth studies the edge of a crackling energy blade.

shards.name: Knight of Shards
shards.desc: An armored rider charges forward with a blazing laser lance.

shards.name: Queen of Shards
shards.desc: A poised strategist raises a crystalline blade beneath storm-lit glass.

shards.name: King of Shards
shards.desc: A commanding figure holds a massive laser greatsword amid controlled chaos.

vaults.name: Ace of Vaults
vaults.desc: A chrome hand presents a glowing quantum core before an open vault gate.

vaults.name: Two of Vaults
vaults.desc: A juggler balances two quantum cores linked by an infinity filament.

vaults.name: Three of Vaults
vaults.desc: Architects collaborate around a structure embedded with three glowing sigil-coins.

vaults.name: Four of Vaults
vaults.desc: A guarded figure clutches a core tightly while standing atop secured vault doors.

vaults.name: Five of Vaults
vaults.desc: Two struggling figures pass a radiant cathedral vault whose light they cannot access.

vaults.name: Six of Vaults
vaults.desc: A benefactor distributes quantum cores using a balanced chrome scale.

vaults.name: Seven of Vaults
vaults.desc: A patient engineer observes seven embedded cores slowly charging.

vaults.name: Eight of Vaults
vaults.desc: An artisan refines a row of quantum cores at a glowing workbench.

vaults.name: Nine of Vaults
vaults.desc: A self-sufficient figure stands in a vault garden of humming cores.

vaults.name: Ten of Vaults
vaults.desc: A lineage of citizens gathers beneath an arch embedded with ten glowing sigil-coins.

vaults.name: Page of Vaults
vaults.desc: A studious initiate examines a quantum core with intense focus.

vaults.name: Knight of Vaults
vaults.desc: A steady guardian rides forward holding a stabilized core like a sacred relic.

vaults.name: Queen of Vaults
vaults.desc: A nurturing sovereign sits among flourishing energy gardens, core resting gently in her lap.

vaults.name: King of Vaults
vaults.desc: A grounded ruler sits upon a throne of vault doors, scepter tipped with a radiant core.
